title: Stripe: AI Transformation Lead, Marketing
description: Headquarters: San Francisco, New York, Seattle, Chicago, Atlanta, Remote in the US Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team The Stripe Marketing organization is undergoing a fundamental transformation in how it works. We're building a team of Forward Deployed AI Accelerators (FDAs) embedded directly with marketing cohorts to make AI the default mode for all work — not an occasional tool, but the foundation of how every marketer at Stripe executes. Today, marketers are already achieving remarkable results — building their own data dashboards, creating agents that compress multi-day processes, and authoring tools that accelerate workflows. The FDA team exists to take what's working and systematically scale it across the entire marketing organization. What you'll do As a Forward Deployed AI Accelerator, you'll be embedded with a cohort of 25–45 marketers organized by functional team, shared workflow, or location. You'll build alongside them, and you'll help them fundamentally change how they operate. Your measure of success is the number of workflows you've permanently transformed and the extent to which those in your cohort start any task with an AI tool. Responsibilities Identify and document the highest-leverage workflow transformations within your cohort's day-to-day work by deeply understanding their processes and outputs Build custom tools, agents, automations, and skills tailored to each marketer's specific responsibilities Coach and partner with each marketer through a progressive journey — from awareness, to first win, to regular AI integration, to full workflow transformation, to self-sufficiency Teach marketers to build and iterate on their own tools over time, creating independence Recognize patterns across your cohort and systematically scale what works — a tool built for one marketer will be reusable for their peers Document every tool, playbook, and transformation pattern you build so the entire FDA team uses each other's work Share wins visibly within your cohort and with leadership to build momentum, inspire, and celebrate success Track individual and cohort progress rigorously against a defined maturity model, moving every marketer toward self-sustaining, AI-first work Prepare marketers for an agentic future — not just prompt writing, but designing, building, and overseeing autonomous, multi-agent workflows Who you are We're looking for people who have already lived the transformation they'll be driving for others. You've used AI to fundamentally change how work gets done, not as a novelty, but as your default operating mode. You are a deep AI practitioner. You build agents, automations, and tools fluently. You don't just know what AI can do in theory. You've built things that changed how real teams operate, and the people you built for actually use what you shipped. You build in real time alongside the people you support. You spot transformation opportunities and execute on them. You look at a team's workflows and see where AI changes the economics: where existing work can be done in a fraction of the time, or where entirely new programs become viable that weren't worth doing before. Then you build the thing, not just the slide. You understand marketing work. You either have direct experience in marketing or quickly learn the workflows, deliverables, tools, and pressures of your assigned cohort. You know that understanding someone's work is a prerequisite to transforming it. You are a pattern recognizer. When you build something that works for one person, you immediately see how it applies to others. You think in systems, not one-off solutions. You are a strong communicator. You explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, adapt your style to different people, and make progress visible to leadership and stakeholders. You are high-caliber, persistent, and versatile. Your skills and experience are valuable across the company. You're the kind of person who succeeds in many roles at Stripe. You bias toward action and speed. You'd rather show someone a working proof-of-concept on their own deliverable today than present a polished deck about what's theoretically possible next quarter. You are comfortable with ambiguity and evolution. This is a new team building a new operating model. The playbook will be rewritten as we learn. You thrive in that environment. Minimum requirements 5+ years of professional experience in a role requiring diagnostic thinking, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration Demonstrated, hands-on experience building and deploying AI-powered agents, tools, automations, or workflows that real people use in their actual work, whether that made existing processes meaningfully more efficient or made previously unviable work possible for the first time Proficiency with AI development tools and platforms (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, custom agent frameworks, API integrations, workflow automation tools) Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and adapt your style to different learners Comfort working across multiple workstreams and relationships simultaneously (you'll be supporting 25–45 marketers at varying stages of their AI journey) Track record of coaching, teaching, or enabling others, with evidence that people you've helped actually changed how they work Preferred qualifications Experience in a formal AI transformation role where the job was substantially about identifying opportunities for workflow transformation and executing on them with hands-on builds Experience helping people become more expert AI users and capable builders Experience in marketing, marketing operations, growth, or a closely adjacent function, including familiarity with marketing technology stacks (e.g., Marketo, Salesforce, analytics platforms, content management tools) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stripe-ai-transformation-lead-marketing

title: Senior AI Developer / AI Engineer
description: Vil du være med å forme hvordan virksomheter bruker kunstig intelligens?AI er i ferd med å endre måten virksomheter utvikler tjenester, løser utfordringer og jobber på. Nå søker vi erfarne AI-utviklere som ønsker å være med på denne utviklingen for et spennende og litt annerledes norsk konsulent hus i Oslo.Vi ser etter deg som har solid erfaring fra programvareutvikling og teknologi, gjerne 10 år eller mer, og som har opparbeidet deg sterk kompetanse innen kunstig intelligens, generativ AI og moderne utviklings metodikk.Du er opptatt av mer enn teknologi i seg selv. Du ser mulighetene AI gir, forstår hvordan teknologien kan skape verdi og har kompetansen til å omsette ideer og behov til løsninger som fungerer i praksis.Her får du muligheten til å jobbe med spennende AI-prosjekter, utforske ny teknologi og være med på å utvikle løsninger som kan endre hvordan virksomheter jobber.Hva vil du jobbe med?Du vil få en sentral rolle i utviklingen av moderne AI-løsninger, fra idé og arkitektur til implementering og produksjons setting.Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet omfatte:Designe, utvikle og implementere AI-baserte løsninger for ulike virksomheter.Utvikle løsninger basert på generativ AI, store språk modeller (LLM) og intelligente AI-agenter.Integrere AI-teknologi med eksisterende systemer, applikasjoner og data plattformer.Utforske og implementere teknologier som Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio og Azure AI.Benytte AI-assisterte utviklerverktøy for å effektivisere og videreutvikle utviklingsprosessen.Bidra med teknologivalg, løsningsarkitektur og rådgivning knyttet til AI-strategi og implementering.Dele erfaringer og bidra til å videreutvikle AI-kompetansen i fagmiljøet.Hvem ser vi etter?Vi tror du har en solid teknisk bakgrunn og et genuint engasjement for hvordan AI kan brukes til å skape nye muligheter.Vi ser gjerne at du har:Minimum 10 års erfaring innen programvareutvikling og moderne teknologi plattformer.Erfaring med AI-utvikling, maskinlæring eller generativ AI.God forståelse for LLM-er, prompt engineering, RAG og AI-agenter.Erfaring med API-er, system integrasjoner og skybaserte løsninger.Kompetanse innen ett eller flere programmeringsspråk, eksempelvis Python, C#, Java eller TypeScript.Erfaring med Azure, AWS eller tilsvarende skyplattformer.Det er spesielt interessant om du har erfaring med:Microsoft Copilot og Copilot Studio.Azure AI Foundry og Azure OpenAI.GitHub Copilot, Claude Code eller tilsvarende AI-assisterte utviklerverktøy.Utvikling av egne AI-agenter og autonome arbeidsflyter.Å ta AI-løsninger fra konsept og prototype til produksjon.Vi er også interessert i deg som har en mer spesialisert AI-bakgrunn, eksempelvis som AI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer eller AI Architect, kombinert med solid forståelse for programvareutvikling og systemarkitektur.Hvem er du?Du er en erfaren teknolog som er nysgjerrig på hva som kommer, og som liker å utfordre etablerte måter å jobbe på. Du følger utviklingen innen AI tett, men er samtidig opptatt av å skille mellom det som er spennende teknologi og det som faktisk skaper verdi.Du trives med å utforske nye løsninger, dele kunnskap og diskutere teknologiske muligheter med andre. Du evner å gjøre komplekse problemstillinger forståelige og liker å jobbe tett med både utviklere, arkitekter og kunder.Vi tror også du motiveres av å være en faglig drivkraft – en som både bidrar med egen kompetanse og inspirerer andre til å tenke nytt.Hva kan du forvente?Vår kunde er et norsk konsulenthus innen teknologi med en litt annerledes tilnærming til konsulentbransjen. De leverer tjenester innen programvareutvikling, arkitektur, design, skyteknologi og prosjektledelse, og jobber med å utvikle digitale løsninger for både private og offentlige virksomheter.Her blir du en del av et sterkt teknologimiljø med engasjerte kolleger, korte veier fra idé til handling og gode muligheter til å påvirke både teknologivalg og faglig retning.Du får jobbe med aktuelle problemstillinger i et fagfelt som utvikler seg raskt, og muligheten til å være med på å forme hvordan kundene tar i bruk neste generasjons AI-løsninger.Er du klar for å bruke erfaringen din til å forme fremtidens teknologi?Vi vil gjerne høre fra deg! title: Senior/Staff ML Scientist - Bidding & Optimization (f/m/d)
description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile app growth and monetization, challenging the status quo of adtech by redefining how apps acquire users and generate revenue. Our two products, Playtime Arcade and adjoe Ads, sit at opposite ends of the mobile advertising spectrum: rewarded engagement and programmatic in-app advertising. Together they run on 13% of the world’s smartphones , connecting advertisers, publishers, and hundreds of millions of users, with one goal: making mobile advertising work better for everyone in the ecosystem. Next-Gen Machine Intelligence for Auctions & Real-Time Bidding The Data Science Research team builds the foundational algorithms that govern real-time bidding, budget pacing, and allocation mechanics across our products. Operating as a horizontal deep-tech layer, the team leverages advanced AI—specifically reinforcement learning, objective-based optimization, and control theory—to deliver critical systems that perfectly harmonize advertiser ROI, platform health, and user relevance. These frameworks scale adjoe’s products beyond standard industry limitations, utilizing behavioral and transactional data from over 770 million users . The team operates at the intersection of high-load, low-latency engineering, auction mechanism design, and state-of-the-art machine learning . Acting as the company’s internal science bar raiser, they translate complex business constraints into mathematical objectives. The stack is optimized for high throughput: PyTorch for training deep learning and RL models, distributed architectures for large-scale Bayesian inference, Trino and Athena for querying massive user-behavior data lakes, and dedicated GPU infrastructure. The full lifecycle of these AI capabilities is owned by the team—from academic paper translation and offline prototyping to deploying core algorithmic frameworks built to sustain ultra-low latency, real-time production environments evaluating tens of thousands of requests per second. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: PhD or equivalent research depth, with a production track record. You have a PhD in CS, Statistics, Math, or Physics (or an MSc with extensive industry research) and a track record of peer-reviewed publications in fields like Computational Advertising, Auction Theory, Mechanism Design, or Game Theory. You’ve spent 4+ years optimizing complex systems through automated algorithms in AdTech, marketplaces, or high-frequency trading. You translate research into production, not just prototypes. You distill SOTA research into robust, production-ready code optimized for sub-millisecond latency. At adjoe, that means architecting sophisticated auction mechanics, real-time bidding engines, and allocation algorithms serving millions of requests across a stack built on 770 million users. Deep expertise in Reinforcement Learning and Optimization. You have hands-on, deep theoretical and technical expertise in objective-based optimization, control theory, or RL applied specifically to bidding, pricing strategy, and budget pacing under extreme production constraints. Mastering high-dimensional data at scale. Large-scale Bayesian inference and handling sparse, high-dimensional advertising data are core to your work. You are strongly proficient in Python and related stacks, and know exactly how to architect scalable data pipelines to feed real-time optimization models. Raises the technical bar around them. You lead architectural debates, collaborate tightly with Product Managers and Engineers to map business goals to mathematical objective functions, mentor junior scientists, and drive the team’s research direction without needing a roadmap handed to you. 🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. What’s in It for You? At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day. Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries. Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum. Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams. Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other. Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy. We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
